title: Reuse a provider before implementing a new source
brief: MemTable exposes materialized partitioned batches; ViewTable exposes a logical plan; ListingTable composes supported file formats and stores. Custom providers can reuse these execution components.

choices.tradeoff: Owns in-memory table data; does not perform file pruning.
Requires store mapping, schema and listing/read configuration.
Reuses a plan, not necessarily materialized results.

choices.choose_when: Source behavior cannot be expressed by existing providers
choices.tradeoff: Implement the scan/capability contract; do not rebuild formats/stores unnecessarily.

claims.statement: MemTable receives schema and Vec<Vec<RecordBatch>> (outer partitions). TableProvider::scan builds Arc<dyn ExecutionPlan>; execution yields batches later.
ObjectStore registration belongs to the RuntimeEnv registry. Contexts may share it. URL scheme/authority and ListingTableUrl/file paths have different responsibilities.
Supply known schema to avoid unnecessary inference, but validate compatibility. Declare partition columns and inspect statistics/pruning; file discovery and metadata reads have costs.

implementation: Select the source representation and lifecycle first.
Verify read projection, partition schema and predicate behavior on a small source-to-result fixture.
unknowns: Cloud authentication, listing costs and invalidation depend on the selected ObjectStore/deployment; local probes do not qualify them.

evidence.scope: Pinned hosted rustdoc; availability depends on the consumer profile.
Only the named assertions in the recorded Cargo profile.

invalidation.reason: Review changed signatures, docs, availability, and newly viable alternatives.
